convention: All p,R,u,h,r,s,channel,original exponent and orientation marks travel through their declared maps. Local support labels are not dropped when amplitudes become zero.

maps.name: Canonical source
maps.inverse_and_fibres: sigma is determined by q mod4; R=sigma q and A=(p+R)/4. q=R/sigma with the type retained.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: No prime vertex or auxiliary range is discarded.

maps.name: Centered divisor bijection
maps.inverse_and_fibres: u=product t^(e_t+beta_t); beta_t=v_t(u)-e_t.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Same exponent vector at every local modulus; no independent CRT choices.

maps.name: Fine coefficient observation
maps.domain: free integer module on original beta labels
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Fibre sums; kernel generated by nonreference differences in each actual residue fibre. Recover with all differences retained.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Residue values alone lose multiplicities and witnesses; supported zero is not absence.

maps.name: Ordered E/M return
maps.codomain: positive ordered rational equation solution in integers
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Formulas (6)-(7); the channel, p and distinguished denominator retained.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: E reflected test first negates beta. The channels are not identified.

maps.name: Auxiliary first-half recoding
maps.codomain: E state with first denominator y<p/2
maps.inverse_and_fibres: (h,r,s,kappa)->(h,kappa,s,r), permutation (y,A,z), inverse the same switch.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: No M state exists in the larger range. Not deletion of that source.

maps.name: Actual period quotient
maps.inverse_and_fibres: K=Stab_G(W); W is complete inverse image of S in Gamma.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Boolean membership descends; coefficient values need not be uniform. Ambient and effective indices remain separate.

maps.name: Local extension coordinates
maps.inverse_and_fibres: g -> (pi(g),g/s(pi(g))); multiply using omega=s(c)s(d)/s(cd).
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: No comparison of different vertex K groups without a further map.

maps.name: Complete factor-edge incidence
maps.codomain: all r with (r/p)=-1, weighted by v_r(A_q)
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Given q,r recover m=v_r(A_q),B=A_q/r^m,c=A_q/r.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: All even positive edge weights retained, including at p3361,q977.

maps.name: Successor arithmetic source
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Keep p and edge; successor is exact integer; its factorization is computed separately.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: No transfer of source prime exponents to the new factorization is asserted.

maps.name: Character observation
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Identity proved by reciprocity, and supplementary law at t=2.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: A sign does not recover the factor or the full residue-group class.

maps.name: Composite successor target CRT
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Inverse ar*(r^-1 mod3)+3b*(3^-1 modr) modulo3r.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: 3q is a nonunit. The correction -4cr and the same original word are indispensable.

maps.name: Common unchanged-divisor span
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Literal inclusions, inverse reads the identical integer u on their intersection.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Outside the intersection no unchanged-divisor map exists; other proposed maps are not ruled out.

maps.name: Centered vector and gate transition
maps.inverse_and_fibres: beta_r=beta_q+v(A_q)-v(A_r); E gate unchanged, M gate plus Delta.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Modulus changes; a source hit can become a miss even on this domain.

maps.name: All-hit reachability
maps.domain: original complete directed graph with gate labels
maps.codomain: distance to nearest hit or infinity
maps.inverse_and_fibres: A chosen distance-decreasing original edge reconstructs a terminating path; its terminal word returns ES.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: No path exists from the greatest closed failure set.

maps.name: Closed-failure reduction
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Successor-closed failed-set certificate; finite elimination <=|V|.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: A failed cycle with an exit is not a closed-set certificate.

maps.name: Strong-component quotient
maps.codomain: condensation graph with member lists and original edges
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Membership plus original edges reconstructs graph; SCC labels alone do not.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Bottom component means no outgoing edge outside it.

maps.name: Cycle coefficient recurrence
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Recurrence (23); retain cyclic order and starting point.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Chosen cycle may omit other exits; closure is a separate factor test.

maps.name: Integer cycle inverse
maps.domain: ordered coefficient word satisfying all converse checks
maps.codomain: prime p and distinct prime vertices q_i
maps.inverse_and_fibres: h=gcd T_i, p=(D-S)/h, q_i=T_i/h.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Primality, signs, ranges, actual edge factors, no-hit predicates and closure must all be checked.

maps.name: Forget cycle origin
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Exactly l rotations, retained as inverse fibre.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Reverse order is not presumed to be a cycle.

maps.name: Additional neutral multiplier source
maps.inverse_and_fibres: Keep q and s; inverse sigma mark explicit; not identified with canonical source.
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: Each extra source must actually be evaluated; no universal success theorem imported.

maps.name: Same-prime multiplier comparison
maps.domain: two admissible ports s,t at q
maps.inverse_and_fibres: gcd(A_s,A_t)=gcd(A_s,(t-s)/4).
maps.information_loss_and_exceptions: For difference4 the source factors are coprime; a new success is not transport of an old divisor.
